big-island.overview: The Big Island has real surf, though it is quieter than the famous breaks of Oahu or Maui. Honoli'i on the east side is a river mouth break for intermediates and experts, while Kahalu'u on the Kona side offers a beginner-friendly reef. Winter brings larger swells to exposed coasts, but the island's rocky shoreline and trade winds mean finding the right spot takes some local knowledge. The water is warm enough to surf without a wetsuit year-round.
